The main takeaway from our work is that
the estimated carrier frequency of 1 in 4000 females in the general female population is higher than previously thought and is comparable to that of fragile X syndrome, which is 1 in 3500.

functional analysis is necessary for the classification of variants in the SCL6A8 gene and the estimated carrier frequency of 1 in 4,000 females in the general female population is important information for genetic counseling and prenatal diagnosis.
